answers.sql: SELECT (SELECT f1.amount FROM financials f1 WHERE f1.period_end='2024-10-27' AND f1.measure='Revenue' AND f1.basis='GAAP') - (SELECT g.midpoint * (1.0 + g.range_width / 100.0) FROM guidance g WHERE g.fiscal_period='Q3FY2025' AND g.measure='Revenue' AND g.basis='GAAP') AS revenue_gap;

SELECT (SELECT f.amount FROM financials f WHERE f.period_end='2024-10-27' AND f.measure='Gross profit' AND f.basis='GAAP') + (SELECT SUM(a.amount) FROM adjustments a WHERE a.period_end='2024-10-27' AND a.measure='Gross profit' AND a.months=3) AS adjusted_gross_profit;

SELECT (SELECT (f.amount + (SELECT SUM(a.amount) FROM adjustments a WHERE a.period_end='2024-10-27' AND a.measure='Gross profit' AND a.months=3)) / (SELECT f2.amount FROM financials f2 WHERE f2.period_end='2024-10-27' AND f2.measure='Revenue' AND f2.basis='GAAP') * 100.0 FROM financials f WHERE f.period_end='2024-10-27' AND f.measure='Gross profit' AND f.basis='GAAP') AS adjusted_gross_margin;

SELECT ((SELECT (f.amount + (SELECT SUM(a.amount) FROM adjustments a WHERE a.period_end='2024-10-27' AND a.measure='Gross profit' AND a.months=3)) / (SELECT f2.amount FROM financials f2 WHERE f2.period_end='2024-10-27' AND f2.measure='Revenue' AND f2.basis='GAAP') * 100.0 FROM financials f WHERE f.period_end='2024-10-27' AND f.measure='Gross profit' AND f.basis='GAAP') - (SELECT midpoint + range_width / 100.0 FROM guidance WHERE fiscal_period='Q3FY2025' AND measure='Gross margin' AND basis='non-GAAP')) * 100.0 AS margin_gap;
